note: Every line below was read on the cited page on 2026-11-27 (WebFetch). 'reported' means the page presents it as an allegation or suspicion, not a finding. Where two pages disagree, both are kept.

voting.jurors: 100 voters, all of whom are journalists selected from the top 100 FIFA nations with one representative per country
voting.ballot: Each juror chooses their top 10 players in descending order from the list of 30
voting.tie_break: number of first-place votes, then second-place votes, and so on

website_leak.time: shortly after 5:15 PM London time on Monday; the ceremony was still several hours away
website_leak.what: The official Ballon d'Or website published articles announcing different winners: Harry Kane, Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal, plus the women's candidates Alexia Putellas and Ewa Pajor (beIN)
website_leak.quote_mbappe_headline: Kylian Mbappé wins the 2026 Ballon d'Or thanks to his consistency at the highest levels
website_leak.explanation_status: One possible explanation is that the organizers had prepared several articles in advance. It remains unclear exactly how the articles went live or whether their removal was part of an effort to contain the mistake. (reported, not confirmed)

police_investigation.complaint_by: France Football, the magazine that runs the Ballon d'Or
police_investigation.suspected: suspected manipulation and the leaking of information relating to the results of the 2026 Ballon d'Or; owners of prediction accounts had got hold of information that was not yet public
police_investigation.profit: nearly 200,000 euros net across the 12 accounts on a predictions platform
police_investigation.status: reported allegations only. The only confirmed fact in the article is that France Football filed a complaint. The manipulation, if any occurred, remains unproven. No jurors are named.

juror_rijec.name: Dravko Rijec
juror_rijec.omitted: Lamine Yamal, who finished third overall
juror_rijec.his_top3: Rodri first, Haaland second, Messi third
juror_rijec.reason: He overweighted World Cup performances rather than club form
juror_rijec.quote: From the outset, I acknowledge my mistake and take responsibility for it, as a member of the France Football Ballon d'Or 2026 jury, in assessing Harry Kane's performance, after I placed him only sixth on the list of the ten players I selected.
juror_rijec.kane_world_cup: six World Cup goals and one assist, reaching the semifinals with England

derived.rijec_gap: A first place is worth 15 and a sixth place is worth 5, so a ballot with Kane first instead of sixth gives him 10 more points
